_comment: Cover per blog post (faithwall-covers skill). Edit slug/ref/palette/hook/tag/icon/badge, then run: node scripts/build-blog-thumbnails.mjs {slug}. hook: 2-5 words, one *accent* word, never the title. Verse text, file and alt are filled in by the script (KJV from public/bible/kjv).

covers.text: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
covers.alt: iPhone lock screen showing Psalm 86:7 (KJV) as a wallpaper
